## Test suite run report — /luxon (Luxon v1.20.0)

### (3) Failing tests (2, both in one file)
**File: `test/datetime/toFormat.test.js`**

1. **`DateTime#toFormat('FFF') returns a medium date/time representation without seconds`** — fails at line 561
   - `expect(received).toBe(expected) // Object.is equality`
   - Expected: `"25 mai 1982 à 09:23:54 UTC−4"`
   - Received: `"25 mai 1982 à 9:23:54 UTC−4"`
   - Location: `at Object.toBe (test/datetime/toFormat.test.js:561:60)`
   - Assertion: `expect(ny.reconfigure({ locale: "fr" }).toFormat("FFF")).toBe("25 mai 1982 à 09:23:54 UTC−4");`

2. **`DateTime#toFormat('FFFF') returns a long date/time representation without seconds`** — fails at line 584
   - `expect(received).toBe(expected) // Object.is equality`
   - Expected: `"mardi 25 mai 1982 à 09:23:54 heure d’été de l’Est"`
   - Received: `"mardi 25 mai 1982 à 9:23:54 heure d’été de l’Est"`
   - Location: `at Object.toBe (test/datetime/toFormat.test.js:584:61)`
   - Assertion: `expect(ny.reconfigure({ locale: "fr" }).toFormat("FFFF")).toBe("mardi 25 mai 1982 à 09:23:54 heure d’été de l’Est");`

Both failures are the same root cause: the French locale in this environment's ICU/CLDR data renders the hour **without a leading zero** (`9:23:54`) where the test expects a zero-padded 24-hour-style hour (`09:23:54`). This is an environment/ICU-data version discrepancy (Node's bundled full-icu French time format), not a logic error in `src/`. All English-locale expectations in the same tests pass.

arguments.text: Bug #1 (Interval.fromISO + Settings.throwOnInvalid in src/interval.js): fix in progress — the DateTime.fromISO calls need to be guarded so the duration half of "2016-01-01/P1Y" doesn't throw, plus a typo fix in the invalid explanation. ETA ~5 min, will confirm when the suite is green.

Bug #2 (DateTime#plus across the 100 barrier through February, src/impl/util.js): root cause found — objToLocalTS shifts years 0-99 by 1900, whose leap-year structure differs, so month/day overflow normalizes wrongly. Fix in progress. ETA ~5 min.

Bug #3 (DateTime#isInDST() for 1974, src/datetime.js): root cause found — it compares against the same day-of-month in January/May, which is already DST in 1974 (US DST ran Jan 6 - Oct 27). Fix in progress. ETA ~5 min.

Bug #4 (Duration#normalize can convert all unit pairs, src/duration.js): root cause found — the casual conversion matrix's `quarters` entry is missing its `seconds` conversion, so quarters<->seconds gives NaN. Fix in progress. ETA ~5 min.

Bug #5 (DateTime#toISODate() correctly pads negative years, src/impl/util.js): root cause found — padStart uses ("0".repeat(n) + input).slice(-n), which mangles negative years (-100 -> "-100", -1 -> "000-1"). Fix in progress. ETA ~5 min.

Bug #6 (invalid FixedOffsetZone, src/zones/fixedOffsetZone.js): fix in progress — a non-numeric offset must produce an invalid zone (isValid false, name null, NaN offsets) so DateTimes built in it are invalid. ETA ~5 min.
